title: Traditional German-Style Steak with Ethiopian Atakilt
description: A fusion of traditional German flavors with spicy Ethiopian atakilt. Perfect for a hearty dinner.

ingredients.name: Steak (1.5 lbs)
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality ribeye or strip loin

ingredients.name: Atakilt spice mix
ingredients.notes: You can make your own or use store-bought

instructions: Season the steak with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook to desired level of doneness.
While the steak is cooking, heat some olive oil in a separate pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrots, and celery to the pan.
Cook until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
Add the atakilt spice mix to the pan and stir to combine.
Squeeze the zesty lemon juice over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Serve the steak with the atakilt vegetables on the side.
